name: AI Content Lifecycle
description: Uses the drupal/ai chat provider to assess whether content is outdated and records the verdict on a 'content_life_cycle' tracking entity for editor review.
project_description: AI Content Lifecycle helps content editors find stale or incorrect content. An admin configures which content entity types and bundles to check and a per-bundle prompt describing what counts as outdated; a batch process then renders each entity, converts it to Markdown, and asks the site's configured drupal/ai chat provider to return a strict JSON verdict ({mark_for_update, reason}). When the model flags an item, the module creates or updates a revisionable 'content_life_cycle' entity referencing the content and stores the reason plus a review status (pending/analyzed/reviewed/updated/ignored). Editors work the queue from the entity's admin collection and an optional Views integration that relates lifecycle records to their nodes. All LLM access goes through the drupal/ai provider abstraction, so this module holds no API keys or HTTP client of its own.
